briefing.headline: Harbour lead 2-0 at the break against the run of territory

working.text: Kestrel are pressing intensely (lower PPDA) compared with Harbour.
Kestrel win the ball much higher up the pitch than Harbour (mean turnover location).
Kestrel carry more of the game into the final third than Harbour by count and per-window mean.

not_working.text: Kestrel have conceded two goals despite similar overall possession and xG numbers.

predictions.claim: Kestrel will crowd Harbour's centre so Harbour's centre channel entries decrease by at least 30%.
Kestrel's PPDA will increase by at least 20% as their press is maintained into the second half.
Kestrel will increase their final-third entries by at least 20% as they chase the game.

working.text: Harbour have been effective through the centre of the final third, using it for the largest share of entries.
Harbour have taken two goals from 1.46 xG and four shots on target.
Harbour maintain similar pass completion and progressive passing to Kestrel.

not_working.text: Harbour press far less intensely than Kestrel (higher PPDA).
Harbour win the ball much deeper than Kestrel (lower turnover height).

predictions.claim: Harbour will increase their final-third entries by at least 20%.
Harbour will increase their progressive passes by at least 15% to move the ball more directly.
Harbour will decrease Kestrel's high regains by at least 10% by adjusting to Kestrel's high press.
